column1: 22880§incorporate§ɪnˈkɔːpəreɪt§This will depend on when carmakers incorporate the necessary monitoring and control systems into their vehicles.§这将取决于汽车制造商何时将必要的监测控制系统**整合**到汽车上。§改译文：原译「安装」不是 incorporate（纳入，合并）的意思，改为「整合」
22881§trace§treɪs§The origin of modern architecture can be traced back to the social and technological changes of the 18th and 19th centuries.§现代建筑的起源可**追溯**到18、19世纪出现的社会和科技变革。§
22882§convey§kənˈveɪ§His poem conveyed a sense of sorrow.§他的诗**表达**了一种悲伤的情感。§
22883§boundary§ˈbaʊndri§Mount St. Helens is located along the boundary of two of the moving plates that make up the Earth's crust.§圣海伦斯火山位于组成地壳的两大移动板块的**边界线**上。§
22884§frank§fræŋk§Will you be frank with me about this matter?§在这件事上你能不能**坦白**地跟我说？§

22885§bonus§ˈbəʊnəs§Scrapping farm-price support and protection for coal-mining offers a two-fold bonus: a cleaner environment and a more efficient economy.§取消农产品价格补贴和煤矿开采保护有双重**好处**：第一，营造了更干净的环境；第二，发展了更高效的经济。§
22886§militant§ˈmɪlɪtənt§One militant group warned the government to take notice.§一个**激进**的团体警告政府要注意。§
22887§starve§stɑːv§Thousands of people starved during the war.§战争中，成千上万的人**饿死**。§
22888§refresh§rɪˈfreʃ§My job is to make sure that you all feel relaxed and refreshed.§我的工作就是保证你们都感觉放松且**精力充沛**。§

22889§dystrophy§ˈdɪstrəfi§In 1986, American researchers identified the genetic defect underlying one type of muscular dystrophy.§1986年，美国研究人员确认了导致一种肌肉**营养不良**症的遗传缺陷。§改译文：muscular dystrophy 是肌肉营养不良症，原译「萎缩症」括不出 dystrophy（营养不良），改为「营养不良症」
22890§conduce§kənˈdjuːs§Money, fame and wealth do not always conduce to happiness.§金钱与名利并不一定就能给人们**带来**幸福。§
22891§consulate§ˈkɒnsjələt§Peter's father used to be a consul working in the American consulate in China.§彼得的父亲曾经是一名领事，在美国驻中国**领事馆**工作。§
22892§contaminant§kənˈtæmɪnənt§Before shipment we have to make sure that all equipment is clean and free of contaminants.§装船之前我们需要确定所有的设备都是整洁的、未受到**污染**的。§
22893§demerit§diːˈmerɪt§I was asked to discuss my best friend's merits and demerits objectively.§我需要客观地讨论我最好朋友的优**缺点**。§
22894§denomination§dɪˌnɒmɪˈneɪʃn§Christians of all denominations attended the conference.§各**教派**的基督徒都参加了会议。§
22895§disturbance§dɪˈstɜːbəns§The construction work is creating constant noise, dust and disturbance.§建筑工程带来持续不断的噪音、灰尘以及**混乱**。§
22896§enjoyable§ɪnˈdʒɔɪəbl§There is going to be a very enjoyable TV programme this evening.§今天晚上将有一期非常**有意思**的电视节目。§
22897§expiry§ɪkˈspaɪəri§The expiry date of my credit card is November 12th 2028.§我的信用卡**到期**日是2028年11月12日。§改译文：原译「有效期限是到」括不出 expiry（满期），改为「到期日是」
22898§fluctuation§ˌflʌktʃuˈeɪʃn§The decision was affected by his fluctuation of mood.§这个决定受到他情绪**波动**的影响。§
22899§frequency§ˈfriːkwənsi§There is an increasing frequency of attacks in this primitive tribe.§这个原始部落受到越来越**频繁**的袭击。§
22900§hence§hens§People all believe firmly that the true consequences will be known several days hence.§人们都坚信几天**后**真实的结果将公之于众。§
22901§inadequate§ɪnˈædɪkwət§Mary rejected the $3 million compensation as totally inadequate.§玛丽拒绝了300万美元的赔偿金，她认为那是完全**不够**的。§
22902§keystone§ˈkiːstəʊn§Changes to the social welfare system are the keystone of the government's reforms.§社会福利系统的改革是政府改革的**基础**。§
22903§manifest§ˈmænɪfest§The symptoms of the disease manifested themselves ten days later.§这种疾病的症状在十天后**表现**了出来。§

22904§marginally§ˈmɑːdʒɪnəli§Mother thought the products were marginally more expensive, so she could not afford it this time.§妈妈认为这些商品**稍有点**贵，因此她这次买不起。§改例句：afford 要和 can/could 连用，would not afford 改为 could not afford
22905§moderately§ˈmɒdərətli§Linda did moderately well in the sports competition and she won the third place in the game.§琳达在这次运动会上**适度**发挥，最后取得第三名的成绩。§
22906§noticeable§ˈnəʊtɪsəbl§There has been a noticeable improvement in Tim's learning.§蒂姆的学业有了**明显**的提高。§
22907§optic§ˈɒptɪk§The wound hurt his optic nerve so that he could no longer see things.§伤口触及他的**视觉**神经，他再也看不到东西了。§改例句：表结果的 that 从句前缺 so，补 so
22908§outweigh§ˌaʊtˈweɪ§The risks are vastly outweighed by the potential benefits.§潜在的利益要远远**高于**所要承担的风险。§
22909§adverse§ˈædvɜːs§Smoking can produce substantial adverse effects on the heart and lungs.§吸烟会对人的心脏和肺造成严重的**危害**。§
22910§finale§fɪˈnɑːli§No other performer has managed to equal their grand finale.§他们的**压轴大戏**令其他表演者望尘莫及。§
22911§astonish§əˈstɒnɪʃ§The news astonished everyone.§这个消息使所有人**大吃一惊**。§
22912§charge§tʃɑːdʒ§Drivers will be charged according to the roads they use.§根据司机行驶的道路对其**收费**。§
22913§corps§kɔːz§The Marine Corps experience launched my machinist career. It also made me realize that learning how-to-learn is a powerful tool.§海军陆战**队**的经历开启了我的机械师生涯。它也让我意识到学习如何学习是一个强大的工具。§
22914§module§ˈmɒdjuːl§The school offers you 10-week modules of English courses.§该学校为你提供为期10周的英语课程**单元**。§
22915§petroleum§pəˈtrəʊliəm§This newly discovered substance can burn like petroleum.§这种新发现的物质可以像**石油**一样燃烧。§
22916§stylish§ˈstaɪlɪʃ§Their uniforms are stylish.§他们的制服很**时髦**。§
22917§dump§dʌmp§Dredgers suck up clay and mud and dump them in deeper waters.§挖泥船挖出黏土和泥，然后将其**倒**入更深的水域。§

22918§debris§ˈdebriː§As the sliding ice and snow melted, it touched off devastating torrents of mud and debris, which destroyed all life in their path.§下滑中的冰雪融化后会引发泥**石**流，破坏力极大，摧毁途经的一切生物。§改译文：错别字「催毁」改为「摧毁」
22919§irony§ˈaɪrəni§It reveals the power of the pauses and noises we use to play for time, convey emotion, doubt and irony.§这表现出停顿和噪音的力量，我们用它们来拖延时间，表达情感、质疑和**讽刺**。§
22920§component§kəmˈpəʊnənt§It is often easier to check individual components before assembly takes place in many manufacturing processes.§在许多生产工序中，在组装之前先检查单个**零部件**通常更容易。§
22921§fieldwork§ˈfiːldwɜːk§Elinor's fieldwork, followed up by her experimental work, pointed us in exactly the right direction.§埃丽诺的**实地考察**，还有随后进行的实验性工作，给我们指出了正确方向。§
22922§contaminate§kənˈtæmɪneɪt§Chemical fertilisers and pesticides may contaminate water supplies.§化肥和杀虫剂可能会**污染**水源。§
22923§applicant§ˈæplɪkənt§We have interviewed twenty-six applicants and none of them are qualified.§我们已经面试了26个**申请者**，没一人符合条件。§
22924§strap§stræp§This strap on my briefcase is broken.§我公文包的这根**带子**断了。§
22925§fundamental§ˌfʌndəˈmentl§The fundamental conditions and resources for health are peace, education, food, a viable income, and a stable ecosystem.§和平、教育、食物、足以维持生计的收入和稳定的生态系统是健康的**基本**条件和源泉。§

22926§conclusion§kənˈkluːʒn§At the clinic we have come to the conclusion that the major cause of back pain is not with the design of chairs, but in the way we sit in them.§临床试验得出的**结论**是，背痛不是由椅子的设计引起的，而是我们的坐姿造成的。§
22927§intensity§ɪnˈtensəti§The pulse laser is increasing its intensity.§脉冲激光的**强度**在不断增加。§
22928§notable§ˈnəʊtəbl§The most notable of these activities was the Woman's Exhibition.§在这些活动中，最**引人注目**的是妇女作品展。§
22929§implement§ˈɪmplɪment§Policy makers struggle to define and implement appropriate legislation.§政策制定者们致力于阐释和**执行**适当的法规。§
22930§cervical§ˈsɜːvɪkl§Smoking is thought to cause about 14 percent of leukemia and cervical cancers.§约14％的白血病和**宫颈**癌被认为是由吸烟引发的。§
22931§plot§plɒt§The plot of this film was too complicated for me.§这部电影的**情节**对我来讲太复杂了。§改音标：书上印成 plɔt，全书短元音 o 都写 ɒ，只有这里印成 ɔ
22932§acquaint§əˈkweɪnt§Films provide an ideal opportunity to acquaint viewers with something unknown.§电影给观众提供了一个**了解**未知事物的绝佳机会。§
22933§violence§ˈvaɪələns§Capital punishment is essential to controlling violence in society.§死刑对控制社会上的**暴力**事件具有重要意义。§
22934§revolve§rɪˈvɒlv§Fifteen satellites all revolve about the planet's equator.§15颗卫星都绕着这颗行星的赤道**旋转**。§
22935§vegetarian§ˌvedʒəˈteəriən§The restaurant offers special meals for vegetarians.§这家饭店为**素食者**准备了特别的食物。§
22936§ratio§ˈreɪʃiəʊ§The male to female ratio of volunteers is 4 to 5.§志愿者中男女**比例**为4比5。§
22937§scream§skriːm§The students screamed in excitement.§学生们激动得**尖叫**起来。§
22938§steep§stiːp§It's very steep here and the surface is a little slippery.§这儿很**陡**，地面还有点滑。§
22939§interior§ɪnˈtɪəriə(r)§The secret of the versatility of glass lies in its interior structure.§这种多功能玻璃的奥秘就在于它的**内部**结构。§
22940§analogous§əˈnæləgəs§The task was strictly analogous to the one that we had finished before.§这个任务和我们先前完成的那个极为**相似**。§
22941§high-tech§ˌhaɪ ˈtek§The architectural style usually referred to as high-tech was emerging.§经常被称为**高科技**的建筑风格涌现了出来。§
22942§aggressive§əˈɡresɪv§The incentive for the more aggressive use of rockets came not from within the European continent but from far-away India.§将火箭用作更具**攻击性**武器的动机并非来自欧洲大陆，而是来自遥远的印度。§
22943§process§ˈprəʊses§Reforming the educational system will be a difficult process.§教育制度的改革将是一个艰难的**过程**。§
22944§hum§hʌm§The hum of conversation died away as the curtain rose.§幕布升起时，**嗡嗡**的谈话声渐渐消失。§
22945§sinister§ˈsɪnɪstə(r)§In your remarks you alluded to certain sinister developments.§你的话语中暗示了一些**不祥**的势头。§
22946§refinement§rɪˈfaɪnmənt§The progress in refinement of machine tools has been substantial in recent years.§近年来，机床的**改进**取得了相当大的进展。§
